reviews.title: This App Has Changed My Life
reviews.text:
A therapist recommended this app to me years ago, and over time I’ve gotten in the habit of using it at least a couple times a week. Ive noticed I instinctively open the app whenever I’m going through a hard time, and use it as a sort of “journal”. 
Seeing the data change over time is absolutely fascinating and incredibly helpful for me to see. I’ve learned things about my emotional health that I never would have known about otherwise, and can use that knowledge to recognize patterns and (thanks to the AI function) identify harmful thinking traps!
I also love that you can invite your provider to be able to view your entries, which would be so useful for people in therapy! 
Thank you, HWF. 

(And it’s FREE?!👏🏻🙌🏻)

reviews.title: update idea
reviews.text: i was on another app that also does what this app does, but it didn’t have as many emotions so i switched. as someone who does daily and monthly reflections, i appreciated that the other app had an option to view all of my emotions for the month at once. i’d like to see if a page that puts the emotions i put down for every day of the month is possible with this app.

reviews.title: Great for Quick Check Ins
reviews.text: I have utilized this app as a personal and honest check in for myself to help reflect on how I am feeling and managing my emotions throughout the day. It is also really helpful to be able to add a journal entry so that I can track what is causing that emotion. This has been great to reflect back during my therapy sessions. I have recommended this app to friends as a great tool.

reviews.title: Simple and effective
reviews.text: While the color scheme is a little loud, it is an altogether well designed app. The UX/UI seems targeted for a smaller screen than my own, but a reasonable stop gap has been implemented allowing for the expansion to use the whole screen. Still a little apprehensive about what is happening in the background as some of this information may be intimately personal, but overall a thorough design and implementation. Kudos.

reviews.title: Therapist Outside of Therapy
reviews.text:
I have been using HWF for 670 days and this is what I would like to say:
• It is a tool to help you practice and remember what you  learned in therapy.
•Accessible during high emotions to help you ground yourself. Obviously available during pleasant emotions as well. 
• It’s free!! It’s not one of those apps that you download then there is something within the app that you have to pay for.
THANK YOU HWF!! Please keep the app free.

reviews.title: New update is…
reviews.text: Please reverse the app to how it looked before. Applications and log tabs I enjoyed are no longer there and the style feels very corporate and harder to find things in comparison to how simple it was before…and I see many other users agree! Please change it back!

reviews.title: Great App - Unintentionally Biased
reviews.text: I thought this was a great app, it helped me start to name and understand my feelings. However, over time, I began to dislike the forced category of pleasant vs unpleasant. Not all feelings fit neatly into this, and I started to associate unpleasant feelings with ‘bad’, which is not the case. I’ve learned that those labeled as unpleasant are actually some of the most meaningful ones. So great app, great design, eye opening for me, but they should rethink the labeling in my opinion.

reviews.title: GET RID OF THE AI!!!!!
reviews.text: i loved this app so much. i used it a lot and it genuinely helped me. they added ai features and that is so so disappointing. ai has NO place in mental health. this app already has so much going for it. adding ai features isn’t going to make it any more liked or downloaded and it isn’t going to make it anymore helpful. the only redeeming part is that you have the option to turn it off. ai is not a mental health professional. it should NOT be analyzing my feelings and writings and giving some uneducated, flat, surface level opinions on why i think i feel the way i do. the app says “ai is not a replacement for a licensed professional” it should stay that way. no matter how you look at it, that’s the only way it can been seen. it’s not a “tool” to help you figure out your emotions, that’s what a therapist is for. adding ai will only make people’s issues worse. i give it two stars because i used to be very attached to this app, but i unfortunately cannot see the value in continuing to use something that blatantly does not care about its users.

reviews.title: Great free and functional mood journal
reviews.text: I really like this mood journal app. You can select from different moods, add a journal entry and data about how you’re feeling physically and connect to other data like health, weather, and sleep. There are also videos and exercises for breathing, meditation, etc. I like that it shows charts with trends by week or month, although I wish there was more flexibility in the trending displays and a way to share the overview analysis with someone rather than just sharing an export of the entries or just an in the moment notification. Overall it’s hard to beat that it’s totally free and no ads!

reviews.title: Amazing, life changing app
reviews.text: I have never written a review for an app, but this one truly deserves it. I wasn’t expecting much after it was recommended by my therapist. I’ve used apps that are supposedly designed to help you understand your emotions, and they all seem like money grabs that give you baseline or surface level insight. however, this app is truly a gem. there seems to be a genuine interest from the creators to want to help people overcome their feelings and sentiments. the video resources are a fabulous tool, and I deeply appreciate how there are so many words to describe how one is feeling, whether it be good, bad or indifferent. so many other features that you simply must download to play with/explore. definitely a go to if you want to pour into yourself in the form of emotion regulation and understanding.

reviews.title: First ever review
reviews.text:
I never write reviews. Ever. For anything. This is my first and probably one of the only ones I ever do write. This app is really nice. It’s good for journaling, for exploring emotions, for building your mental health, for sleep, literally for everything that’s related to mental fitness. And somehow, they did this with no ads and no in app subscriptions. I really appreciate the team behind this app and I heavily recommend it to everyone.
It’s not a replacement for a psychiatrist but it is definitely a good addition!

reviews.title: I like it :)
reviews.text:
This is honestly one of the best emotional tracking apps I’ve ever used and I’ve tried a lot of them. It’s simple and easy to use while also providing you enough emotions to actually put down what you’re feeling. 

For someone like me that’s huge cause I have a hard time finding the words to express my feelings. 

It’s also great that you can share with a friend because I’m sure a partner or someone close would want to know how you’re feeling when you can’t express it.
